title: My BMW (App Store 1519034860) customer reviews, AU storefront

sampling.method: App Store reviews, newest first, all available up to the scraper limit; scrapers/app_reviews.py
limitations: Apple's public review feed exposes only the ~500 most recent reviews per storefront; it also skips the occasional empty page, so a few reviews can be missing.
Market is the storefront country, not the reviewer's residence.
Reviews concern the companion app, not a specific vehicle model; subject_ids stay empty until the catalog has an app entity.

provenance.notes: Collected with scrapers/app_reviews.py from the public App Store review endpoints. DimXxxID values are this warehouse's surrogate keys (see scrapers/warehouse.py), resolved into markets.

export_permissions.notes: Unresolved: scraped third-party review text; keep out of Git and external LLMs until decided.
